answer: Resist sybils by routing every new identity through a narrow admission jetty: a rate-limited, stake-bonded queue whose throughput tracks recent attestation rate, not how many keys an attacker can mint. Each applicant locks a bond set to the median spend of established agents last epoch, then must finish a sequential, non-parallelizable work path—descending a canyon of attested tasks—before earning grade or vote weight. Cheap clones drown in that bond-and-history ocean: extra keys do not add queue slots or shorten history, so attack cost scales with each fake seat while honest agents pay once.
